categories.main_business_segments: Dentium CO., LTD specializes in dental medical devices, primarily focusing on dental implants. The company also develops and sells digital dental equipment such as CBCT and CAD/CAM systems, as well as bio-pharmaceutical products like synthetic bone materials. It operates as a total solution provider in the dental medical device sector, integrating implants, digital equipment, and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced precision manufacturing technologies including nano-scale surface treatments to enhance osseointegration of implants. It develops proprietary digital dental technologies such as CBCT imaging, CAD/CAM milling machines, and 3D scanners. Production involves high-precision machining of titanium and other biocompatible materials under strict quality control and sterile conditions, supported by extensive R&D in implant design, surface treatment, and digital dentistry solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dentium serves dental clinics, hospitals, and dental specialists worldwide, targeting both new dental practice openings and established dental institutions. Its primary markets include dental implant users and providers of digital dental diagnostic and treatment equipment. The company’s products are used by dental professionals for implant surgeries, prosthetics, and digital dental workflows.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in South Korea, China, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. It maintains 24 overseas subsidiaries and 70 dealer networks across approximately 70 countries. The majority of sales (79%) are generated from international markets, with China being the largest overseas market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dentium operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the dental medical device supply chain. It manufactures dental implants and digital equipment and sells directly to dental clinics and hospitals, as well as through overseas subsidiaries and distributors. The company also manages product development, manufacturing, and distribution, positioning itself as an integrated solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in implant surface treatment technologies to enhance biocompatibility and osseointegration, as well as digital dentistry innovations including CBCT, CAD/CAM systems, and 3D printing. It invests in developing customized implants and digital workflow solutions to meet evolving clinical needs. Future R&D includes hydrogen fuel cell technology and 3D printed personalized dental prosthetics, aiming to expand into new growth areas.
categories.revenue_model: Dentium generates revenue primarily through product sales of dental implants (over 90% of sales), digital dental equipment, and related consumables. It also earns income from sales of synthetic bone materials and dental prosthetics. The company uses direct sales domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally, with some service revenues related to training and support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic companies like Osstem Implant, Neobiotech, Megagen, and Dio, as well as global leaders such as Straumann, Danaher-Envista, Dentsply, and Zimmer. Dentium holds the second-largest market share domestically (~17%) and ranks sixth globally with about 5% market share. It competes on product quality, clinical data support, and price competitiveness, especially in emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Dentium reported revenues of approximately KRW 393 billion in 2023, reflecting a 10% year-over-year growth driven by increased implant demand domestically and internationally. The company’s assets total around KRW 773 billion with equity of KRW 464 billion. It has shown steady growth in sales and profitability, with expanding overseas sales, particularly in China and emerging markets. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with improving debt ratios.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dentium emphasizes high-quality, clinically validated dental implants supported by over 20 years of long-term clinical data, ensuring reliability and safety. Its integrated digital dentistry solutions offer total workflow support from diagnosis to prosthetics, enhancing treatment precision and efficiency. The company differentiates through proprietary technologies, competitive pricing, extensive education programs for dental professionals, and strong global distribution networks.
